# Essex Dental Implants

> Independent matching service connecting patients in Essex with verified, GDC-registered dental implant clinicians. Not a clinical provider.

## About

- [About the matching service](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/about/): how matching works, editorial standards, contact routes.
- [Privacy notice](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/privacy/): UK GDPR data handling.
- [Terms of use](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/terms/): scope of service, fees, liability.

## Service pillars

- [Single-tooth implants](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/services/single-tooth/)
- [Multiple-teeth implants](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/services/multiple-teeth/)
- [Full-arch implants (All-on-4 / All-on-6)](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/services/full-arch/)
- [Bone grafting and sinus lifts](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/services/bone-grafting/)
- [Immediate implants](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/services/immediate-implants/)
- [Implant-retained dentures](https://www.essexdentalimplants.com/services/implant-dentures/)
